MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

2. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 11
   D. 7

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 13

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

6. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 9

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

9. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 1
   C. 9
   D. 20

10. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

12. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 65

13. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

15. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 13

16. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
